{{Quote|The Empire's engineering branch is tasked with constructing garrisons and other structure of strategic value, including ore mines, power generators, and space stations.|[[Admiral/Legends|Admiral]] [[Wullf Yularen/Legends|Wullf Yularen]], ''[[Imperial Handbook: A Commander's Guide]]''|<ref name="IH:ACG" />}}
The '''Imperial Engineering Corps''', also called '''Imperial Engineering''' or '''Imperial Corps of Engineers''', were a corps of [[Engineer/Legends|engineers]] in the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire's]] [[Imperial Military/Legends|Military]]. They were responsible for building operation for the military, such as constructing bases.

==Description==
The Imperial Engineering Corps was a branch of the [[Imperial Military/Legends|Imperial Military]] in charge of the construction of various military facilities, such as [[Garrison/Legends|garrisons]], and strategic structures, such as [[Space station/Legends|space stations]], [[Power generator/Legends|power generators]] and [[Mining/Legends|mining]] facilities.<ref name="IH:ACG" /> The Engineering Corps therefore worked closely with the [[Imperial Army/Legends|Imperial Army]] and the [[Imperial Navy/Legends|Imperial Navy]],<ref name="AoRCR">[[Star Wars: Age of Rebellion Core Rulebook|''Star Wars: Age of Rebellion'' Core Rulebook]]</ref> though the Navy had its own [[Engineering Division]]. The Engineering Corps was also tasked with searching out for obedient alien populations to act as laborers.<ref name="IH:ACG" />

Members of the Engineering Corps were trained at the [[Imperial Engineers Academy]] on [[Carida/Legends|Carida]]<ref name="TEGtW">''[[The Essential Guide to Warfare]]''</ref> and had to receive biannual certification from the prestigious [[Institute of Starship Engineers]].<ref name="GG9">''[[Galaxy Guide 9: Fragments from the Rim]]''</ref> Officers of the Engineering Corps used a specific [[Military rank/Legends|military rank]] system. It was made of "specialist" ranks similar to the ranks of the Imperial Army, namely [[General/Legends|general]], [[Colonel/Legends|colonel]], [[Major/Legends|major]], [[Commander/Legends|commander]], [[Captain/Legends|captain]], [[Lieutenant/Legends|lieutenant]] and officer. Among those, junior ranks were prefixed by "engineering": engineering captain, engineering lieutenant and [[Engineering officer/Legends|engineering officer]]. High-ranking Engineering officers that raised above the rank of general are promoted at the rank of [[Vice Admiral/Legends|vice admiral]] with the honorific title of master engineer.<ref name="TEGtW" />

Some Imperial engineers would be deployed in ground operations as battlefield engineers, operating on damaged vehicles and laying down defenses. They wore [[Helmet/Legends|helmets]] similar to those of [[Imperial gunner/Legends|Imperial gunners]] and were equipped with [[blast cannon]]s, [[F-187 fusioncutter]] and [[detonation pack]]s.<ref name="Battlefront2">''[[Star Wars: Battlefront II]]''</ref> Otherwise, Imperial engineers were simply armed with [[Light blaster pistol/Legends|light blaster pistols]].<ref name="AoRCR" />

==History==
{{Quote|It was Imperial Transport who brought you there, Imperial Supply who arranged and provisioned that house for you, and Imperial Engineering who built the camouflaged island landing site for your use.|Grand Admiral Thrawn|<ref name="TLC">''[[The Last Command]]''</ref>}}
Engineering's constructions included the [[Imperial Ore Facility]] on [[Raxus Prime/Legends|Raxus Prime]] and the [[Raxus Prime Imperial Shipyard]] in orbit of Raxus. The latter used metal collected from the surface to build [[Star Destroyer/Legends|Star Destroyers]] and was mentioned to be the most important construction project undertaken by the Corps at the time, around [[2 BBY/Legends|2 BBY]].<ref name="TFU">''[[Star Wars: The Force Unleashed]]'' — Databank</ref>

Following the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]], the Imperial Engineering Corps was tasked to carry out a recovery operation in the [[Yavin system/Legends|Yavin system]] to salvage scrap of the [[DS-1_Orbital_Battle_Station/Legends|Death Star]].<ref name="SWG:JtL">''[[Star Wars Galaxies: Jump to Lightspeed]]''</ref>

In [[9 ABY/Legends|9 ABY]], [[Grand Admiral/Legends|Grand Admiral]] [[Mitth'raw'nuruodo/Legends|Thrawn]] mentioned to [[Joruus C'baoth]], the mad [[Cloning/Legends|clone]] of [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Jorus C'baoth]], that the Corps was responsible for building him an island on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] of [[Jomark/Legends|Jomark]].<ref name="TLC" />

In the [[Voren Na'al's journal|journal]] of a [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]] [[Historian/Legends|historian]] [[Voren Na'al/Legends|Voren Na'al]], [[Mount Tantiss/Legends|Mount Tantiss]] on [[Wayland/Legends|Wayland]] was assumed by the [[New Republic Xenoarchaeology Division]] search teams to have been honeycombed by the Imperial Engineering Corps.<ref name="TLCS" />
